name: Reunificación Familiar (Ley 18.250)

requirements.blocker_text: Eligible relatives under Law 18.250: spouse, concubine partner (with judicial documentation of the relationship), single minor children (or adult children with disabilities), and parents.

The sponsor in Uruguay must be a permanent resident, or have residency 'in process,' with proven means of support: monthly income at or above the National Minimum Wage, evidenced by BPS employment history (3+ months) or, for the self-employed, a BPS certificate plus accounting/notarial certification.
requirements.fix_path: Establish qualifying sponsor status and income.

evidence_required.document: Vital records (birth/marriage certificates), legalized/apostilled if foreign
Recent color photograph, white background, under 6 months old

outcome.duration_length: matches the sponsor's own residency validity; the reunified family member has 30 days after arrival to formalize their own residency

sources.title: Sitio oficial de la República Oriental del Uruguay -- Solicitud de Reunificación Familiar: eligible relatives (Ley 18.250), sponsor income test, free of charge

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Uruguay's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1, free of charge, processed by email (reunificacion@mrree.gub.uy). Notably, the sponsor need only have residency 'in process' (not necessarily already granted) provided they can show qualifying means -- a more permissive sponsor bar than many other countries in this dataset require. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects the 3-year 'family constituted' naturalisation track (see uy_naturalisation), which a reunified family member would plausibly qualify for once resident, though this specific linkage was not independently confirmed.
